title: HTML/Nomani Deepfake Phishing Campaigns Allegedly Use AI-Generated Content to Defraud Social Media Users

behaviors.text: AI-generated deepfakes were reportedly used in the "HTML/Nomani" phishing campaign to mimic legitimate platforms like booking services and lured [person] into investment scams.
These scams allegedly leveraged realistic fake content to deceive [person] on social media for the purposes of financial fraud.
This campaign was part of the rising misuse of AI in cybercrime during the second half of 2024.
